title: Explainable Multimodal Depression Recognition in Clinical Interviews via PHQ-Aligned Symptom Summarization
abstract: arXiv:2501.16106v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in multimodal depression recognition for clinical interviews (MDRC) have demonstrated the potential of AI systems by integrating textual, acoustic, and facial cues. However, existing methods pay limited attention to interpretability, thereby constraining reproducibility and clinician review. To address this, we introduce Explain-MDRC, an explainable MDRC framework that mirrors clinical workflows by generating structured symptom summaries from text and integrating them with nonverbal cues for recognition. Specifically, we construct Explain-DAIC, a dataset based on DAIC-WOZ and enriched with PHQ-8-aligned summary annotations, providing a foundation for developing models with built-in interpretability. translated_title: 基于PHQ对齐症状摘要的可解释多模态临床访谈抑郁识别
translated_abstract: arXiv:2501.16106v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：近期在多模态临床访谈抑郁识别（MDRC）领域的进展，通过整合文本、声学和面部线索，展示了AI系统的潜力。然而，现有方法对可解释性关注有限，从而限制了可重复性和临床医生审查。为解决这一问题，我们引入了Explain-MDRC，一个可解释的MDRC框架，它通过生成结构化症状摘要来模拟临床工作流程，并将这些摘要与非语言线索相结合进行识别。具体而言，我们构建了Explain-DAIC，一个基于DAIC-WOZ的数据集，并丰富了与PHQ-8对齐的摘要注释，为开发具有内置可解释性的模型提供了基础。我们进一步提出了PhqCML，一个将PHQ-8对齐的症状摘要与PHQ感知对比学习及摘要信息多模态融合相结合的模型。自动评估指标和专家评估表明，Explain-MDRC在识别性能上具有竞争力，同时提供了可解释的症状级理由，促进了临床可接受性和模型验证。
tldr: 该论文提出了Explain-MDRC框架，通过生成PHQ-8对齐的症状摘要并结合非语言线索，实现了可解释的多模态抑郁识别，并构建了Explain-DAIC数据集和PhqCML模型，以提升临床可接受性和模型验证能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Explain-MDRC, a framework that generates PHQ-8-aligned symptom summaries and integrates them with nonverbal cues for interpretable multimodal depression recognition, along with the Explain-DAIC dataset and PhqCML model to enhance clinical acceptability and model validation.
